title: PIN-default-policy-pack: Short default policy pack for a buyer
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** pilot milestone 1
**Done check:** file:seed/autonomy/default-policy-pack.json
**Status:** closed live; verified by the done check on every build

Today's policy is long and written as owner directives; a buyer needs a short default pack. Done when the pack is committed and the seed loads it.

Source: site/pins.json (SITE-PINS-1); the public /engineers, /how and /roadmap pages render this item, and scripts/build_site_roadmap.py --check fails when the claim and the item drift.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 220.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
